page_title: UDI 1-2 ROM | Udinese v AS Roma 26/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+4' Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. The ball goes out of play. AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.
90+3' The referee blows his whistle as Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) was too aggressive in his challenge.
90+1' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) brings his opponent down. Simone Sozza has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Simone Pafundi (Udinese) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
88' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mile Svilar intercepts the ball.
86' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
84' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post.
84' Angelino (AS Roma) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
81' Claudio Ranieri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) replacing Artem Dovbyk.
81' The manager makes a subsitution with Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) coming on for Lorenzo Pellegrini.
80' Arthur Atta (Udinese) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
80' Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Simone Sozza saw the whole situation.
79' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
78' Kosta Runjaic prepares a substitution. Rui Modesto is replaced by Alexis Sanchez (Udinese).
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Martin Payero trots off the pitch and is replaced by Simone Pafundi (Udinese).
75' Rui Modesto (Udinese) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
74' Angelino (AS Roma) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
72' Martin Payero (Udinese) latches on to a loose ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot on goal, but the effort lacks accuracy and flies high over the bar.
70' Substitution. Devyne Rensch did his best and is replaced by Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma).
69' A lofted cross from Florian Thauvin (Udinese) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
68' Neat passing move from Udinese in order to create new attacking opportunities.
66' Substitution. Sandi Lovric is replaced by Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese).
65' Kosta Runjaic has decided to make a change. Arthur Atta (Udinese) replaces Jesper Karlstrom.
64' 1 - 2 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Razvan Sava no chance!
64' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
63' Razvan Sava (Udinese) trips an opposition player and Simone Sozza signals a foul. Penalty awarded! AS Roma will take a penalty kick.
62' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Razvan Sava easily deals with the threat.
60' AS Roma control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
58' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
58' The referee allows time for a substitution. Tommaso Baldanzi will be replaced by Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma).

58' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) hits a piledriver from the edge of the box, but Razvan Sava acrobatically dives to stop the effort. Superb save! The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to AS Roma.
57' Martin Payero (Udinese) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Mile Svilar pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
56' AS Roma players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
55' Simone Sozza blows his whistle and it's Angelino (AS Roma) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
52' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) is penalised.
52' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
51' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
50' 1 - 1 Goal! Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) puts the penalty low into the middle of the goal and past Razvan Sava.
50' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
49' The players claim that Christian Kabasele (Udinese) handled the ball inside the box and it seems they are right. AS Roma are given a huge opportunity to score - it's a penalty kick!
48' Angelino (AS Roma) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
48' Half-chance! Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) plays a pass into the box, but Razvan Sava reacts well to snuff out the attack.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Claudio Ranieri gives a chance to Eldor Shomurodov and Zeki Celik (AS Roma) is off.
46' The second half has just started.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+6' A goal, which was scored by Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma), was disallowed due to offside.

45+4' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom left corner is, however, superbly saved by Mile Svilar!
45+4' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
45+1' Rough tackle by Evan Ndicka (AS Roma). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
44' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Simone Sozza blows for a foul.
43' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Simone Sozza signals that the goal stands! The Udinese players celebrate.
40' The goal for Udinese is subject to a VAR review by the referee! He's obviously unsure or he received a message.
38' 1 - 0 Sandi Lovric floats a lovely ball in from the free kick to Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese), and he slots the ball inside the right post to increase the score to 1:0.
37' Simone Sozza shows the yellow card to Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) for a heavy challenge.
36' AS Roma are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.

34' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well over the crossbar.
33' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.

32' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Simone Sozza with no other option than to blow for a foul.

31' Angelino looks up and sends over a pin-point cross to Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) near the penalty spot, but he totally fluffs his lines and plants a tame header well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
30' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) reacted quickly inside the box and got on the end of the resulting corner. He smashed the ball towards the middle, but the goalkeeper pulled off a great reflex save.
30' Udinese have a corner.
29' Rui Modesto (Udinese) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Now Udinese have a corner.
28' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
27' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. AS Roma will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
27' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

26' Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom left corner. Razvan Sava has a clear sight of it makes a comfortable save. AS Roma get a corner.
26' Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
24' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Udinese.
22' Jaka Bijol (Udinese) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort well wide of the left post.
21' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) sees a yellow card from Simone Sozza after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
20' Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
19' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
18' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) is flagged for offside.
16' The AS Roma players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
14' AS Roma couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Razvan Sava (Udinese) leaped high and intercepted a cross.

13' Martin Payero (Udinese) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Simone Sozza blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. There is a free kick near the sideline to AS Roma.
13' AS Roma fail to score from a corner as Razvan Sava (Udinese) leaps to collect the ball.
12' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to AS Roma.
11' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) plays a through ball but overhits it.
10' The Udinese players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
9' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) commits a rough foul. Simone Sozza stops the game and makes a call.
7' Kosta Runjaic is forced to make a change. Isaak Toure is unable to continue due to injury, Christian Kabasele (Udinese) comes on.
5' Isaak Toure (Udinese) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
4' Angelino (AS Roma) and Lorenzo Pellegrini attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
3' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Rui Modesto (Udinese) heads on.
2' Flag goes up against Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
2' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) commits a foul and Simone Sozza immediately signals a free kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Udinese will have the kick-off.
Simone Sozza is introduced as the referee for today's match.
